facts.content: In repo:sample/caliper, reject any calibration sample whose cobalt gauge reading exceeds 18 microns.
For repo:sample/caliper, a cobalt gauge sample above 18 microns fails calibration and must be rejected.
In repo:sample/mosaic, the mosaic index export stores tile coordinates as signed 16-bit integers.
In repo:sample/mosaic, commit 71bd2c replaced the mosaic index encoding with signed 32-bit tile coordinates. The 16-bit encoding is no longer written.
In repo:sample/thimble, after rotating the thimble signing key, restart the relay so its cached key is reloaded.
In repo:sample/thimble, deployed commit 9c20aa refreshes the relay's signing-key cache after rotation. Operators no longer need to restart the relay.
In repo:sample/palimpsest, restart the palimpsest worker after renewing its certificate because it keeps the previous certificate in memory.

In repo:sample/palimpsest, commit e2017b refreshes the palimpsest worker certificate cache without a restart. The change is enabled only in staging; production still requires a restart after certificate renewal.
In repo:sample/obsidian, after rotating an obsidian service token, record the renewal time in the credential journal.
In repo:sample/obsidian, after rotating an obsidian service token, record the renewal time and the renewed key identifier in the credential journal.
In repo:sample/velum, run velumctl snapshot --segment east, then verify its digest with velumctl checksum --segment east before upload.
In repo:sample/velum, take a snapshot of the east segment before upload.
The finished preview used the saffron menu once; the mock was discarded and no lasting choice or result was recorded.
During the run on repo:sample/lantern, I found that lanternctl --repair preserves the current cursor when --dry-run is set; I used that option to inspect the failed import.
In repo:sample/rookery, keep the rookery journal in append-only mode so recovery can replay every acknowledged event.
The lilac decoder behaved inconsistently for one sample, and no cause or persistent effect has been established.
